title: Just okay.
text: Just okay.. These are just okay in my opinion. They are a bit difficult to clean and everything will stick so you must use parchment! However, They are very sturdy and absolutely do not warp in a hot oven. All my baked goods have come out evenly brown and I didn’t see any hot spots. Another thing that bugs me about these is that they do not nest in each other. I tried to stack on top of each other and they just slip down. Because of this, they take up much more room in your cabinet. I wouldn’t order these again.
